title: Concept: Unbounded append with strncat (c)
description: In c, strncat appends without knowing how much room is left. The classic off-by-one writes a terminator one byte past the allocation and corrupts the neighbouring object.
applicability: C and C++ string building in parsers, log formatters and protocol handlers.
risk: Heap or stack corruption that adjacent data can turn into control-flow hijack; HIGH severity.
